open_deviations.reading: Seek preroll preserves the exact nanosecond Opus PTS
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 sections 5.1.4.1.25 to 5.1.4.1.26 and 11.2: subtract CodecDelay from Block PTS and preserve the decode preroll
open_deviations.candidate: Replays two verified Opus packets before the first wanted occurrence on their track; the common suffix keeps exact PTS, for example 1992500000 ns
open_deviations.reference: The native cue seek skips those two source packets; the common suffix reports rounded PTS, for example 1992000000 ns, with the same packet bytes

open_deviations.reading: Seek preroll preserves distinct zero BlockDuration and exact Opus CodecDelay
open_deviations.candidate: Replays one subtitle and two Opus packets verified against the sequential source; the common suffix preserves 6500000 ns delay and a present zero duration
open_deviations.reference: The native seek skips those three source packets and its common suffix rounds the delay and omits the zero duration; the common bytes agree

open_deviations.reading: CodecDelay subtracts fractional milliseconds on the source clock
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 §§5.1.4.1.25 and 11.2 define CodecDelay in nanoseconds and subtract it from the scaled Block timestamp.
open_deviations.candidate: Retains the nanosecond PTS after subtracting the stored delay, such as 1992500000 ns for a Block near the seek boundary. The landing, first differing payload and packet count agree.
open_deviations.reference: Quantizes the corresponding packet times to Segment ticks, such as 1992000000 ns for that Block.
open_deviations.compat: A caller requiring native demux ticks would use compat::matroska::segment_tick_timestamps.

open_deviations.reading: Nanosecond CodecDelay and an explicit zero-length Block duration survive a seek
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 §§5.1.3.5.3, 5.1.4.1.25 and 11.2 permit a stated zero BlockDuration and require subtracting the nanosecond CodecDelay.
open_deviations.candidate: The same Block is at 1992500000 ns with duration zero. The landing and packet count agree.
open_deviations.reference: The Block is at 1992000000 ns and its zero packet duration is reported as absent.
open_deviations.compat: A caller requiring both Segment-tick rounding and packet-duration sentinel mapping would use compat::matroska::segment_tick_timestamps.

open_deviations.reading: DefaultDuration carries the written nanosecond duration on the seek suffix
open_deviations.clause: RFC 9559 §§5.1.4.1.13 and 11.1 define DefaultDuration in nanoseconds. The fixture video TrackEntry writes 125000000.
open_deviations.candidate: Reports 125000000 ns at the first differing video packet, with the same landing, payload and packet count.
open_deviations.reference: Reports 120000000 ns at the same packet.
open_deviations.compat: A caller requiring the demuxer’s inferred packet durations would use compat::matroska::demux_durations.
